verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗ית בַּֽחֲמִשִׁי֙ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ בָּ֧אוּ אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מִזִּקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִדְרֹ֣שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ לְפָנָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî baš·šā·nāh haš·šə·ḇî·‘îṯ ba·ḥă·mi·šî be·‘ā·śō·wr la·ḥō·ḏeš bā·’ū ’ă·nā·šîm miz·ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl liḏ·rōš ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·yê·šə·ḇū lə·p̄ā·nāy
verses.literal: In the seventh year on the tenth day of the fifth month some of the elders of Israel came . . . to inquire of the LORD and they sat down before me
verses.literalPt: E ACONTECEU, no sétimo ano, no quinto mês, aos dez do mês, que vieram alguns dos anciãos de Israel, para consultarem o SENHOR; e assentaram-se diante de mim.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Então veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶת־ זִקְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הֲלִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֹתִ֖י אַתֶּ֣ם בָּאִ֑ים חַי־ אָ֙נִי֙ אִם־ אִדָּרֵ֣שׁ לָכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām dab·bêr ’eṯ- ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hă·liḏ·rōš ’ō·ṯî ’at·tem bā·’îm ḥay- ’ā·nî ’im- ’id·dā·rêš lā·ḵem nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Son of man speak to the elders of Israel and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says Have you come to inquire of Me As surely as I live I will not be consulted by you declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, fala aos anciãos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Viestes consultar-me? Vivo eu, que não me deixarei ser consultado por vós, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: הֲתִשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֹתָ֔ם הֲתִשְׁפּ֖וֹט בֶּן־ אָדָ֑ם אֶת־ תּוֹעֲבֹ֥ת אֲבוֹתָ֖ם הוֹדִיעֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯiš·pōṭ ’ō·ṯām hă·ṯiš·pō·wṭ ben- ’ā·ḏām ’eṯ- tō·w·‘ă·ḇōṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām hō·w·ḏî·‘êm
verses.literal: Will you judge them will you judge them son of man Confront them with the abominations of their fathers
verses.literalPt: Porventura tu os julgarias, julgarias tu, ó filho do homem? Notifica-lhes as abominações de seus pais;

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ בְּיוֹם֙ בָּחֳרִ֣י בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וָאֶשָּׂ֣א יָדִ֗י לְזֶ֙רַע֙ בֵּ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וָאִוָּדַ֥ע לָהֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָאֶשָּׂ֨א יָדִ֤י לָהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bə·yō·wm bā·ḥo·rî ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl wā·’eś·śā yā·ḏî lə·ze·ra‘ bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wā·’iw·wā·ḏa‘ lā·hem bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wā·’eś·śā yā·ḏî lā·hem lê·mōr ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says On the day I chose Israel I swore an oath . . . to the descendants of the house of Jacob and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt With an uplifted hand I said to them I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: E dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: No dia em que escolhi a Israel, levantei a minha mão para a descendência da casa de Jacó, e me dei a conhecer a eles na terra do Egito, e levantei a minha mão para eles, dizendo: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus;

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נָשָׂ֤אתִי יָדִי֙ לָהֶ֔ם לְהֽוֹצִיאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֶל־ אֶ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֣רְתִּי לָהֶ֗ם זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ צְבִ֥י הִ֖יא לְכָל־ הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū nā·śā·ṯî yā·ḏî lā·hem lə·hō·w·ṣî·’ām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’el- ’e·reṣ ’ă·šer- tar·tî lā·hem zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇaš ṣə·ḇî hî lə·ḵāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: On that day I swore . . . to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them a land flowing with milk and honey the glory . . . of all lands
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia levantei a minha mão para eles, para os tirar da terra do Egito, para uma terra que já tinha previsto para eles, a qual mana leite e mel, e é a glória de todas as terras.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אִ֣ישׁ שִׁקּוּצֵ֤י עֵינָיו֙ הַשְׁלִ֔יכוּ וּבְגִלּוּלֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם אַל־ תִּטַּמָּ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·lê·hem ’îš šiq·qū·ṣê ‘ê·nāw haš·lî·ḵū ū·ḇə·ḡil·lū·lê miṣ·ra·yim ’al- tiṭ·ṭam·mā·’ū ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: And I said to them Each of you must throw away the abominations before his eyes and you must not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Então lhes disse: Cada um lance de si as abominações dos seus olhos, e não vos contamineis com os ídolos do Egito; eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיַּמְרוּ־ בִ֗י וְלֹ֤א אָבוּ֙ לִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֵלַ֔י אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ שִׁקּוּצֵ֤י עֵֽינֵיהֶם֙ לֹ֣א הִשְׁלִ֔יכוּ וְאֶת־ גִּלּוּלֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם לֹ֣א עָזָ֑בוּ וָאֹמַ֞ר לִשְׁפֹּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לְכַלּ֤וֹת אַפִּי֙ בָּהֶ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yam·rū- ḇî wə·lō ’ā·ḇū liš·mō·a‘ ’ê·lay ’îš ’eṯ- šiq·qū·ṣê ‘ê·nê·hem lō hiš·lî·ḵū wə·’eṯ- gil·lū·lê miṣ·ra·yim lō ‘ā·zā·ḇū wā·’ō·mar liš·pōḵ ḥă·mā·ṯî ‘ă·lê·hem lə·ḵal·lō·wṯ ’ap·pî bā·hem bə·ṯō·wḵ ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: But they rebelled against Me and refused . . . to listen None of them - cast away the abominations before their eyes and they did not forsake the idols of Egypt So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Mas rebelaram-se contra mim, e não me quiseram ouvir; ninguém lançava de si as abominações dos seus olhos, nem deixava os ídolos do Egito; então eu disse que derramaria sobre eles o meu furor, para cumprir a minha ira contra eles no meio da terra do Egito.

verses.original: וָאַ֙עַשׂ֙ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֔י לְבִלְתִּ֥י הֵחֵ֛ל לְעֵינֵ֥י הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֣מָּה בְתוֹכָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נוֹדַ֤עְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶם֙ לְעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם לְהוֹצִיאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’a·‘aś lə·ma·‘an šə·mî lə·ḇil·tî hê·ḥêl lə·‘ê·nê hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- hêm·māh ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵām ’ă·šer nō·w·ḏa‘·tî ’ă·lê·hem lə·‘ê·nê·hem lə·hō·w·ṣî·’ām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: But I acted for the sake of My name that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they were living . . . in whose sight I had revealed Myself to Israel by bringing them out of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: O que fiz, porém, foi por amor do meu nome, para que não fosse profanado diante dos olhos dos gentios, no meio dos quais estavam, a cujos olhos eu me dei a conhecer a eles, para os tirar da terra do Egito.

verses.original: וָאֽוֹצִיאֵ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָאֲבִאֵ֖ם אֶל־ הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·w·ṣî·’êm mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wā·’ă·ḇi·’êm ’el- ham·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: So I brought them out of the land of Egypt and led them into the wilderness
verses.literalPt: E os tirei da terra do Egito, e os levei ao deserto.

verses.original: וָאֶתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֶת־ חֻקּוֹתַ֔י וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֖י הוֹדַ֣עְתִּי אוֹתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אוֹתָ֛ם הָאָדָ֖ם וָחַ֥י בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’et·tên lā·hem ’eṯ- ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay wə·’eṯ- miš·pā·ṭay hō·w·ḏa‘·tî ’ō·w·ṯām ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śeh ’ō·w·ṯām hā·’ā·ḏām wā·ḥay bā·hem
verses.literal: And I gave them My statutes and made known to them My ordinances for the man who does these things will live by them
verses.literalPt: E dei-lhes os meus estatutos e lhes mostrei os meus juízos, os quais, cumprindo-os o homem, viverá por eles.

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם אֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָהֶ֔ם לִהְי֣וֹת לְא֔וֹת בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם לָדַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem lih·yō·wṯ lə·’ō·wṯ bê·nî ū·ḇê·nê·hem lā·ḏa·‘aṯ kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·də·šām
verses.literal: I also gave them My Sabbaths as a sign between us . . . so that they would know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them
verses.literalPt: E também lhes dei os meus sábados, para que servissem de sinal entre mim e eles; para que soubessem que eu sou o SENHOR que os santifica.

verses.original: וַיַּמְרוּ־ בִ֨י בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֨י לֹא־ הָלָ֜כוּ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֣י מָאָ֗סוּ אֲשֶׁר֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה אֹתָ֤ם הָֽאָדָם֙ וָחַ֣י בָּהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י חִלְּל֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וָאֹמַ֞ר לִשְׁפֹּ֨ךְ חֲמָתִ֧י עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר לְכַלּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yam·rū- ḇî ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl bam·miḏ·bār bə·ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay lō- hā·lā·ḵū wə·’eṯ- miš·pā·ṭay mā·’ā·sū ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯām hā·’ā·ḏām wā·ḥay bā·hem wə·’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·ṯay ḥil·lə·lū mə·’ōḏ wā·’ō·mar liš·pōḵ ḥă·mā·ṯî ‘ă·lê·hem bam·miḏ·bār lə·ḵal·lō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Yet the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness They did not follow My statutes and they rejected My ordinances though the man who does these things will live by them and they utterly profaned My Sabbaths Then I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and put an end to them in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Mas a casa de Israel se rebelou contra mim no deserto, não andando nos meus estatutos, e rejeitando os meus juízos, os quais, cumprindo-os, o homem viverá por eles; e profanaram grandemente os meus sábados; e eu disse que derramaria sobre eles o meu furor no deserto, para os consumir.

verses.original: וָאֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֑י לְבִלְתִּ֤י הֵחֵל֙ לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצֵאתִ֖ים לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’e·‘ĕ·śeh lə·ma·‘an šə·mî lə·ḇil·tî hê·ḥêl lə·‘ê·nê hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯîm lə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: But I acted for the sake of My name so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out
verses.literalPt: O que fiz, porém, foi por amor do meu nome, para que não fosse profanado diante dos olhos dos gentios perante a vista dos quais os fiz sair.

verses.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִ֗י נָשָׂ֧אתִי יָדִ֛י לָהֶ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְבִלְתִּי֩ הָבִ֨יא אוֹתָ֜ם אֶל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֗תִּי זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ צְבִ֥י הִ֖יא לְכָל־ הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ’ă·nî nā·śā·ṯî yā·ḏî lā·hem bam·miḏ·bār lə·ḇil·tî hā·ḇî ’ō·w·ṯām ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tî zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇaš ṣə·ḇî hî lə·ḵāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: Moreover with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land that I had given them a land flowing with milk and honey the glory . . . of all lands
verses.literalPt: E, contudo, eu levantei a minha mão para eles no deserto, para não os deixar entrar na terra que lhes tinha dado, a qual mana leite e mel, e é a glória de todas as terras;

verses.original: יַ֜עַן בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֣י מָאָ֗סוּ וְאֶת־ חֻקּוֹתַי֙ לֹא־ הָלְכ֣וּ בָהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י חִלֵּ֑לוּ כִּ֛י אַחֲרֵ֥י גִלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם לִבָּ֥ם הֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an bə·miš·pā·ṭay mā·’ā·sū wə·’eṯ- ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay lō- hā·lə·ḵū ḇā·hem wə·’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay ḥil·lê·lū kî ’a·ḥă·rê ḡil·lū·lê·hem lib·bām hō·lêḵ
verses.literal: because they kept rejecting My ordinances refusing to walk in My statutes and profaning My Sabbaths for their hearts continually went after their idols
verses.literalPt: Porque rejeitaram os meus juízos, e não andaram nos meus estatutos, e profanaram os meus sábados; porque o seu coração andava após os seus ídolos.

verses.original: וַתָּ֧חָס עֵינִ֛י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִֽשַּׁחֲתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ עָשִׂ֧יתִי אוֹתָ֛ם כָּלָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḥās ‘ê·nî ‘ă·lê·hem miš·ša·ḥă·ṯām wə·lō- ‘ā·śî·ṯî ’ō·w·ṯām kā·lāh bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Yet I looked on them with pity . . . . . . and did not destroy them or bring them to an end in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Não obstante o meu olho lhes perdoou, e eu não os destruí nem os consumi no deserto.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֤ר אֶל־ בְּנֵיהֶם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּחוּקֵּ֤י אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ אַל־ תֵּלֵ֔כוּ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶ֖ם אַל־ תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ וּבְגִלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם אַל־ תִּטַּמָּֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’el- bə·nê·hem bam·miḏ·bār bə·ḥūq·qê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ’al- tê·lê·ḵū wə·’eṯ- miš·pə·ṭê·hem ’al- tiš·mō·rū ū·ḇə·ḡil·lū·lê·hem ’al- tiṭ·ṭam·mā·’ū
verses.literal: In the wilderness I said to their children Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers or keep their ordinances . . . or defile yourselves with their idols . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas disse eu a seus filhos no deserto: Não andeis nos estatutos de vossos pais, nem guardeis os seus juízos, nem vos contamineis com os seus ídolos.

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֖י לֵ֑כוּ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֥י שִׁמְר֖וּ וַעֲשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem bə·ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay lê·ḵū wə·’eṯ- miš·pā·ṭay šim·rū wa·‘ă·śū ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: I am the LORD your God walk in My statutes keep My ordinances and practice them
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus; andai nos meus estatutos, e guardai os meus juízos, e executai-os.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י קַדֵּ֑שׁוּ וְהָי֤וּ לְאוֹת֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם לָדַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay qad·dê·šū wə·hā·yū lə·’ō·wṯ bê·nî ū·ḇê·nê·ḵem lā·ḏa·‘aṯ kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Keep My Sabbaths holy that they may be a sign between us . . . so that you may know that I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: E santificai os meus sábados, e servirão de sinal entre mim e vós, para que saibais que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיַּמְרוּ־ בִ֣י הַבָּנִ֗ים בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֣י לֹֽא־ הָ֠לָכוּ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֨י לֹא־ שָׁמְר֜וּ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אוֹתָ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה אוֹתָ֤ם הָֽאָדָם֙ וָחַ֣י בָּהֶ֔ם אֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י חִלֵּ֑לוּ וָאֹמַ֞ר לִשְׁפֹּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לְכַלּ֥וֹת אַפִּ֛י בָּ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yam·rū- ḇî hab·bā·nîm bə·ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay lō- hā·lā·ḵū wə·’eṯ- miš·pā·ṭay lō- šā·mə·rū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’ō·w·ṯām ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śeh ’ō·w·ṯām hā·’ā·ḏām wā·ḥay bā·hem ’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay ḥil·lê·lū wā·’ō·mar liš·pōḵ ḥă·mā·ṯî ‘ă·lê·hem lə·ḵal·lō·wṯ ’ap·pî bām bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: But the children rebelled against Me They did not walk in My statutes or carefully observe My ordinances . . . though the man who does these things will live by them and they profaned My Sabbaths So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Mas também os filhos se rebelaram contra mim, e não andaram nos meus estatutos, nem guardaram os meus juízos para os fazer, os quais, cumprindo-os, o homem viverá por eles; eles profanaram os meus sábados; por isso eu disse que derramaria sobre eles o meu furor, para cumprir contra eles a minha ira no deserto.

verses.original: וַהֲשִׁבֹ֙תִי֙ אֶת־ יָדִ֔י וָאַ֖עַשׂ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֑י לְבִלְתִּ֤י הֵחֵל֙ לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אוֹתָ֖ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî wā·’a·‘aś lə·ma·‘an šə·mî lə·ḇil·tî hê·ḥêl lə·‘ê·nê hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’ō·w·ṯām lə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: But I withheld My hand and acted for the sake of My name so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out
verses.literalPt: Mas contive a minha mão, e o fiz por amor do meu nome, para que não fosse profanado perante os olhos dos gentios, à vista dos quais os fiz sair.

verses.original: גַּם־ אֲנִ֗י נָשָׂ֧אתִי אֶת־ יָדִ֛י לָהֶ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְהָפִ֤יץ אֹתָם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וּלְזָר֥וֹת אוֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’ă·nî nā·śā·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî lā·hem bam·miḏ·bār lə·hā·p̄îṣ ’ō·ṯām bag·gō·w·yim ū·lə·zā·rō·wṯ ’ō·w·ṯām bā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: However with an uplifted hand I swore - to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them throughout the lands
verses.literalPt: Também levantei a minha mão para eles no deserto, para os espalhar entre os gentios, e os derramar pelas terras,

verses.original: יַ֜עַן מִשְׁפָּטַ֤י לֹֽא־ עָשׂוּ֙ וְחֻקּוֹתַ֣י מָאָ֔סוּ וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י חִלֵּ֑לוּ וְאַחֲרֵי֙ גִּלּוּלֵ֣י אֲבוֹתָ֔ם הָי֖וּ עֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an miš·pā·ṭay lō- ‘ā·śū wə·ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay mā·’ā·sū wə·’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay ḥil·lê·lū wə·’a·ḥă·rê gil·lū·lê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām hā·yū ‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: For they did not practice My ordinances but they rejected My statutes and profaned . . . My Sabbaths fixing their eyes on the idols of their fathers
verses.literalPt: Porque não executaram os meus juízos, e rejeitaram os meus estatutos, e profanaram os meus sábados, e os seus olhos iam após os ídolos de seus pais.

verses.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָהֶ֔ם חֻקִּ֖ים לֹ֣א טוֹבִ֑ים וּמִ֨שְׁפָּטִ֔ים לֹ֥א יִֽחְי֖וּ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ’ă·nî nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem ḥuq·qîm lō ṭō·w·ḇîm ū·miš·pā·ṭîm lō yiḥ·yū bā·hem
verses.literal: I also gave them over to statutes that were not good and ordinances by which they could not live
verses.literalPt: Por isso também lhes dei estatutos que não eram bons, juízos pelos quais não haviam de viver;

verses.original: וָאֲטַמֵּ֤א אוֹתָם֙ בְּמַתְּנוֹתָ֔ם בְּהַעֲבִ֖יר כָּל־ פֶּ֣טֶר רָ֑חַם לְמַ֣עַן אֲשִׁמֵּ֔ם לְמַ֙עַן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽדְע֔וּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ṭam·mê ’ō·w·ṯām bə·mat·tə·nō·w·ṯām bə·ha·‘ă·ḇîr kāl- pe·ṭer rā·ḥam lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šim·mêm lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer yê·ḏə·‘ū ’ă·šer ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: And I pronounced them unclean through their gifts the sacrifice of every firstborn in the fire . . . so that I might devastate them in order that they would know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: E os contaminei em seus próprios dons, nos quais faziam passar pelo fogo tudo o que abre a madre; para assolá-los para que soubessem que eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶל־ בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בֶּן־ אָדָ֔ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה ע֗וֹד זֹ֚את גִּדְּפ֤וּ אוֹתִי֙ אֲב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם בְּמַעֲלָ֥ם בִּ֖י מָֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên dab·bêr ’el- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ben- ’ā·ḏām wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ‘ō·wḏ zōṯ gid·də·p̄ū ’ō·w·ṯî ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem bə·ma·‘ă·lām bî mā·‘al
verses.literal: Therefore son of man speak to the house of Israel and tell them that . . . this is what the Lord GOD says In this way also your fathers blasphemed Me by their unfaithfulness against Me
verses.literalPt: Portanto fala à casa de Israel, ó filho do homem, e dize-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ainda até nisto me blasfemaram vossos pais, e que procederam traiçoeiramente contra mim.

verses.original: וָאֲבִיאֵם֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ יָדִ֔י לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖הּ לָהֶ֑ם וַיִּרְאוּ֩ כָל־ גִּבְעָ֨ה רָמָ֜ה וְכָל־ עֵ֣ץ עָבֹ֗ת וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־ שָׁ֤ם אֶת־ זִבְחֵיהֶם֙ וַיִּתְּנוּ־ שָׁם֙ כַּ֣עַס קָרְבָּנָ֔ם וַיָּשִׂ֣ימוּ שָׁ֗ם רֵ֚יחַ נִיח֣וֹחֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּסִּ֥יכוּ שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ נִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ḇî·’êm ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·śā·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî lā·ṯêṯ ’ō·w·ṯāh lā·hem way·yir·’ū ḵāl giḇ·‘āh rā·māh wə·ḵāl ‘êṣ ‘ā·ḇōṯ way·yiz·bə·ḥū- šām ’eṯ- ziḇ·ḥê·hem way·yit·tə·nū- šām ka·‘as qā·rə·bā·nām way·yā·śî·mū šām rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·w·ḥê·hem way·yas·sî·ḵū šām ’eṯ- nis·kê·hem
verses.literal: When I brought them into the land that I swore - to give them and they saw any high . . . hill or leafy tree there they offered their sacrifices presented offerings that provoked Me sent up . . . their fragrant incense and poured out . . . their drink offerings
verses.literalPt: Porque, havendo-os eu introduzido na terra sobre a qual eu levantara a minha mão, para lha dar, então olharam para todo o outeiro alto, e para toda a árvore frondosa, e ofereceram ali os seus sacrifícios e apresentaram ali a provocação das suas ofertas; puseram ali os seus cheiros suaves, e ali derramaram as suas libações.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם מָ֣ה הַבָּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֥ם הַבָּאִ֖ים שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקָּרֵ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ בָּמָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·lê·hem māh hab·bā·māh ’ă·šer- ’at·tem hab·bā·’îm šām way·yiq·qā·rê šə·māh bā·māh ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: So I asked them . . . What is this high place to which you go And to this day . . . it is called . . . Bamah
verses.literalPt: E eu lhes disse: Que alto é este, aonde vós ides? E seu nome tem sido Bamá até o dia de hoje.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר׀ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הַבְּדֶ֥רֶךְ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם אַתֶּ֣ם נִטְמְאִ֑ים וְאַחֲרֵ֥י שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֖ם אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ĕ·mōr ’el- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hab·bə·ḏe·reḵ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ’at·tem niṭ·mə·’îm wə·’a·ḥă·rê šiq·qū·ṣê·hem ’at·tem zō·nîm
verses.literal: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says Will you defile yourselves the way your fathers did prostituting yourselves with their abominations
verses.literalPt: Portanto dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Contaminai-vos a vós mesmos a maneira de vossos pais? E vos prostituístes com as suas abominações?

verses.original: וּבִשְׂאֵ֣ת מַתְּנֹֽתֵיכֶ֡ם בְּֽהַעֲבִיר֩ בְּנֵיכֶ֨ם בָּאֵ֜שׁ אַתֶּם֩ נִטְמְאִ֤֨ים לְכָל־ גִּלּֽוּלֵיכֶם֙ עַד־ הַיּ֔וֹם וַאֲנִ֛י אִדָּרֵ֥שׁ לָכֶ֖ם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חַי־ אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אִם־ אִדָּרֵ֖שׁ לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiś·’êṯ mat·tə·nō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ha·‘ă·ḇîr bə·nê·ḵem bā·’êš ’at·tem niṭ·mə·’îm lə·ḵāl gil·lū·lê·ḵem ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm wa·’ă·nî ’id·dā·rêš lā·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’im- ’id·dā·rêš lā·ḵem
verses.literal: When you offer your gifts sacrificing your sons . . . in the fire you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day So should I be consulted by you O house of Israel As surely as I live declares the Lord GOD I will not be consulted by you
verses.literalPt: E, quando ofereceis os vossos dons, e fazeis passar os vossos filhos pelo fogo, não é certo que estais contaminados com todos os vossos ídolos, até este dia? E vós me consultaríeis, ó casa de Israel? Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que vós não me consultareis.

verses.original: וְהָֽעֹלָה֙ עַל־ ר֣וּחֲכֶ֔ם הָי֖וֹ לֹ֣א תִֽהְיֶ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים נִֽהְיֶ֤ה כַגּוֹיִם֙ כְּמִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת לְשָׁרֵ֖ת עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ō·lāh ‘al- rū·ḥă·ḵem hā·yōw lō ṯih·yeh ’ă·šer ’at·tem ’ō·mə·rîm nih·yeh ḵag·gō·w·yim kə·miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ lə·šā·rêṯ ‘êṣ wā·’ā·ḇen
verses.literal: When you say Let us be like the nations like the peoples of the lands serving wood and stone . . . what you have in mind will never come to pass
verses.literalPt: E o que veio à vossa mente de modo algum sucederá, quando dizeis: Seremos como os gentios, como as outras famílias da terra, servindo ao madeiro e à pedra.

verses.original: חַי־ אָ֕נִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אִם־ לֹ֠א בְּיָ֨ד חֲזָקָ֜ה וּבִזְר֧וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֛ה וּבְחֵמָ֥ה שְׁפוּכָ֖ה אֶמְל֥וֹךְ עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’im- lō bə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh ū·ḇiz·rō·w·a‘ nə·ṭū·yāh ū·ḇə·ḥê·māh šə·p̄ū·ḵāh ’em·lō·wḵ ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: As surely as I live declares the Lord GOD - with a strong hand an outstretched arm and outpoured wrath I will rule over you
verses.literalPt: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que com mão forte, e com braço estendido, e com indignação derramada, hei de reinar sobre vós.

verses.original: וְהוֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְקִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִן־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְפוֹצֹתֶ֖ם בָּ֑ם בְּיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְחֵמָ֖ה שְׁפוּכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem min- hā·‘am·mîm wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem min- hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer nə·p̄ō·w·ṣō·ṯem bām bə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh ū·ḇiz·rō·w·a‘ nə·ṭū·yāh ū·ḇə·ḥê·māh šə·p̄ū·ḵāh
verses.literal: With a strong hand an outstretched arm and outpoured wrath I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered
verses.literalPt: E vos tirarei dentre os povos, e vos congregarei das terras nas quais andais espalhados, com mão forte, e com braço estendido, e com indignação derramada.

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־ מִדְבַּ֖ר הָֽעַמִּ֑ים וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֤י אִתְּכֶם֙ שָׁ֔ם פָּנִ֖ים אֶל־ פָּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- miḏ·bar hā·‘am·mîm wə·niš·paṭ·tî ’it·tə·ḵem šām pā·nîm ’el- pā·nîm
verses.literal: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations where I will enter into judgment with you face to face
verses.literalPt: E vos levarei ao deserto dos povos; e ali face a face entrarei em juízo convosco;

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁפַּ֙טְתִּי֙ אֶת־ אֲב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם בְּמִדְבַּ֖ר אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם כֵּ֚ן אִשָּׁפֵ֣ט אִתְּכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer niš·paṭ·tî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem bə·miḏ·bar ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim kên ’iš·šā·p̄êṭ ’it·tə·ḵem nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt so I will enter into judgment with you declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Como entrei em juízo com vossos pais, no deserto da terra do Egito, assim entrarei em juízo convosco, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: וְהַעֲבַרְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑בֶט וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּמָסֹ֥רֶת הַבְּרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·‘ă·ḇar·tî ’eṯ·ḵem ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·ḇeṭ wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem bə·mā·sō·reṯ hab·bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: I will make you pass under the rod and will bring you into the bond of the covenant
verses.literalPt: Também vos farei passar debaixo da vara, e vos farei entrar no vínculo da aliança.

verses.original: וּבָרוֹתִ֣י מִכֶּ֗ם הַמֹּרְדִ֤ים וְהַפּֽוֹשְׁעִים֙ בִּ֔י מֵאֶ֤רֶץ מְגֽוּרֵיהֶם֙ אוֹצִ֣יא אוֹתָ֔ם וְאֶל־ אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יָב֑וֹא וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·rō·w·ṯî mik·kem ham·mō·rə·ḏîm wə·hap·pō·wō·šə·‘îm bî mê·’e·reṣ mə·ḡū·rê·hem ’ō·w·ṣî ’ō·w·ṯām wə·’el- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl lō yā·ḇō·w wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: And I will purge you of those who rebel and transgress against Me I will bring them out of the land in which they dwell but they will not enter . . . the land of Israel Then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: E separarei dentre vós os rebeldes, e os que transgrediram contra mim; da terra das suas peregrinações os tirarei, mas à terra de Israel não voltarão; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֨ם בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה אִ֤ישׁ גִּלּוּלָיו֙ לְכ֣וּ עֲבֹ֔דוּ וְאַחַ֕ר אִם־ אֵינְכֶ֖ם שֹׁמְעִ֣ים אֵלָ֑י וְאֶת־ שֵׁ֤ם קָדְשִׁי֙ לֹ֣א תְחַלְּלוּ־ ע֔וֹד בְּמַתְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם וּבְגִלּוּלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’îš gil·lū·lāw lə·ḵū ‘ă·ḇō·ḏū wə·’a·ḥar ’im- ’ê·nə·ḵem šō·mə·‘îm ’ê·lāy wə·’eṯ- šêm qāḏ·šî lō ṯə·ḥal·lə·lū- ‘ō·wḏ bə·mat·tə·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem ū·ḇə·ḡil·lū·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: And as for you O house of Israel this is what the Lord GOD says Go and serve your idols every one of you But afterward you will surely . . . listen to Me and you will no longer defile My holy name with your gifts and idols
verses.literalPt: Quanto a vós, ó casa de Israel, assim diz o Senhor DEUS; Ide, sirva cada um os seus ídolos, pois que a mim não me quereis ouvir; mas não profaneis mais o meu santo nome com as vossas dádivas e com os vossos ídolos.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְהַר־ קָדְשִׁ֞י בְּהַ֣ר׀ מְר֣וֹם יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה שָׁ֣ם יַעַבְדֻ֜נִי כָּל־ בֵּ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כֻּלֹּ֖ה בָּאָ֑רֶץ שָׁ֣ם אֶרְצֵ֔ם וְשָׁ֞ם אֶדְר֣וֹשׁ אֶת־ תְּרוּמֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְאֶת־ רֵאשִׁ֛ית מַשְׂאוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בְּכָל־ קָדְשֵׁיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇə·har- qāḏ·šî bə·har mə·rō·wm yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh šām ya·‘aḇ·ḏu·nî kāl- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kul·lōh bā·’ā·reṣ šām ’er·ṣêm wə·šām ’eḏ·rō·wōš ’eṯ- tə·rū·mō·ṯê·ḵem wə·’eṯ- rê·šîṯ maś·’ō·w·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵāl qā·ḏə·šê·ḵem
verses.literal: For on My holy mountain the high mountain of Israel declares the Lord GOD there the whole house of Israel all of them will serve Me in the land There I will accept them and will require your offerings and choice gifts along with all your holy sacrifices
verses.literalPt: Porque no meu santo monte, no monte alto de Israel, diz o Senhor DEUS, ali me servirá toda a casa de Israel, toda ela naquela terra; ali me deleitarei neles, e ali requererei as vossas ofertas alçadas, e as primícias das vossas oblações, com todas as vossas coisas santas;

verses.original: בְּרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹחַ֮ אֶרְצֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶם֒ בְּהוֹצִיאִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְקִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִן־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְפֹצֹתֶ֖ם בָּ֑ם וְנִקְדַּשְׁתִּ֥י בָכֶ֖ם לְעֵינֵ֥י הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ ’er·ṣeh ’eṯ·ḵem bə·hō·w·ṣî·’î ’eṯ·ḵem min- hā·‘am·mîm wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem min- hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer nə·p̄ō·ṣō·ṯem bām wə·niq·daš·tî ḇā·ḵem lə·‘ê·nê hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: When I bring you from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered I will accept you as a pleasing aroma And I will show My holiness through you in the sight of the nations
verses.literalPt: Com cheiro suave me deleitarei em vós, quando eu vos tirar dentre os povos e vos congregar das terras em que andais espalhados; e serei santificado em vós perante os olhos dos gentios.

verses.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בַּהֲבִיאִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ יָדִ֔י לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖הּ לַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh ba·hă·ḇî·’î ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·śā·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî lā·ṯêṯ ’ō·w·ṯāh la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then you will know that I am the LORD when I bring you into the land of Israel . . . the land that I swore - to give your fathers
verses.literalPt: E sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR, quando eu vos introduzir na terra de Israel, terra pela qual levantei a minha mão para dá-la a vossos pais.

verses.original: וּזְכַרְתֶּם־ שָׁ֗ם אֶת־ דַּרְכֵיכֶם֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ עֲלִיל֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִטְמֵאתֶ֖ם בָּ֑ם וּנְקֹֽטֹתֶם֙ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל־ רָעוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·zə·ḵar·tem- šām ’eṯ- dar·ḵê·ḵem wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯê·ḵem ’ă·šer niṭ·mê·ṯem bām ū·nə·qō·ṭō·ṯem bip̄·nê·ḵem bə·ḵāl rā·‘ō·w·ṯê·ḵem ’ă·šer ‘ă·śî·ṯem
verses.literal: There you will remember your ways and all the deeds with which you have defiled yourselves and you will loathe yourselves for all the evils you have done
verses.literalPt: E ali vos lembrareis de vossos caminhos, e de todos os vossos atos com que vos contaminastes, e tereis nojo de vós mesmos, por causa de todas as vossas maldades que tendes cometido.

verses.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בַּעֲשׂוֹתִ֥י אִתְּכֶ֖ם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמִ֑י לֹא֩ כְדַרְכֵיכֶ֨ם הָרָעִ֜ים וְכַעֲלִילֽוֹתֵיכֶ֤ם הַנִּשְׁחָתוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh ba·‘ă·śō·w·ṯî ’it·tə·ḵem lə·ma·‘an šə·mî lō ḵə·ḏar·ḵê·ḵem hā·rā·‘îm wə·ḵa·‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯê·ḵem han·niš·ḥā·ṯō·wṯ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then you will know O house of Israel that I am the LORD when I have dealt with you for the sake of My name and not according to your wicked ways and corrupt acts declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: E sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR, quando eu proceder para convosco por amor do meu nome; não conforme os vossos maus caminhos, nem conforme os vossos atos corruptos, ó casa de Israel, disse o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ תֵּימָ֔נָה וְהַטֵּ֖ף אֶל־ דָּר֑וֹם וְהִנָּבֵ֛א אֶל־ יַ֥עַר הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה נֶֽגֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām śîm pā·ne·ḵā de·reḵ tê·mā·nāh wə·haṭ·ṭêp̄ ’el- dā·rō·wm wə·hin·nā·ḇê ’el- ya·‘ar haś·śā·ḏeh ne·ḡeḇ
verses.literal: Son of man set your face toward the south preach against it and prophesy against the forest of the Negev
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto para o caminho do sul, e derrama as tuas palavras contra o sul, e profetiza contra o bosque do campo do sul.

verses.original: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לְיַ֣עַר הַנֶּ֔גֶב שְׁמַ֖ע דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֑ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֡ה הִנְנִ֣י מַֽצִּית־ בְּךָ֣׀ אֵ֡שׁ וְאָכְלָ֣ה בְךָ֣ כָל־ עֵֽץ־ לַח֩ וְכָל־ עֵ֨ץ יָבֵ֤שׁ לֹֽא־ תִכְבֶּה֙ לַהֶ֣בֶת שַׁלְהֶ֔בֶת וְנִצְרְבוּ־ בָ֥הּ כָּל־ פָּנִ֖ים מִנֶּ֥גֶב צָפֽוֹנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā lə·ya·‘ar han·ne·ḡeḇ šə·ma‘ də·ḇar- Yah·weh kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî maṣ·ṣîṯ- bə·ḵā ’êš wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ḇə·ḵā ḵāl ‘êṣ- laḥ wə·ḵāl ‘êṣ yā·ḇêš lō- ṯiḵ·beh la·he·ḇeṯ šal·he·ḇeṯ wə·niṣ·rə·ḇū- ḇāh kāl- pā·nîm min·ne·ḡeḇ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh
verses.literal: Say to the forest of the Negev Hear the word of the LORD This is what the Lord GOD . . . says I am about to ignite in you a fire and it will devour all your trees both green and dry The blazing flame will not be quenched and by it every face from south to north will be scorched
verses.literalPt: E dize ao bosque do sul: Ouve a palavra do SENHOR: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que acenderei em ti um fogo que em ti consumirá toda a árvore verde e toda a árvore seca; não se apagará a chama flamejante, antes com ela se queimarão todos os rostos, desde o sul até ao norte.

verses.original: וְרָאוּ֙ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֔ר כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בִּֽעַרְתִּ֑יהָ לֹ֖א תִּכְבֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’ū kāl- bā·śār kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh bi·‘ar·tî·hā lō tiḵ·beh
verses.literal: Then all people will see that I the LORD have kindled it it will not be quenched
verses.literalPt: E verá toda a carne que eu, o SENHOR, o acendi; não se apagará.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר אֲהָ֖הּ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הֵ֚מָּה אֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֔י הֲלֹ֛א מְמַשֵּׁ֥ל מְשָׁלִ֖ים הֽוּא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·hāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hêm·māh ’ō·mə·rîm lî hă·lō mə·maš·šêl mə·šā·lîm hū
verses.literal: Then I said Ah Lord GOD they are saying of me Is he not just telling parables
verses.literalPt: Então disse eu: Ah! Senhor DEUS! Eles dizem de mim: Não é este um proferidor de parábolas?
